blurb: One of the great encyclopaedic art museums of America, behind two bronze lions on Michigan Avenue.

facts.t: Van Gogh painted his bedroom in the Yellow House three times. The Art Institute has the second version, painted in September 1889 at Saint-Rémy from the first.

facts.h: A Sunday afternoon made of dots
facts.t: Georges Seurat spent two years on A Sunday on La Grande Jatte, finished in 1886, building it from tiny dots of pure colour. It has never been lent since 1958.
